title: Promotion boundary acceptance
text: Given a 20 percent coupon expiring at 2026-09-01T12:00:00.000Z, quotes at -1ms and equal expiry return 200 and total 8000; +1ms returns 422 PROMO_EXPIRED.

title: Inventory reservation contention / acceptance_criteria
text: AC1: stock=1 and two concurrent requests yields one 201, one 409. AC2: replaying a successful idempotency key leaves stock unchanged. AC3: stock never becomes negative.

title: Tenant cache isolation / acceptance_criteria
text: Warm tenant A profile for user 42, request tenant B user 42, assert B displayName and roles. Repeat in reverse order. Missing tenant claim returns 401.
